basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Backend Software Engineer · Golang & Node.js · AWS Microservices · Cloud Security & Compliance · 3.5+ Years

summaries.tcs-casb-cloud-security: Backend Software Engineer with 3.5+ years building distributed microservices in Golang and Node.js on AWS, with hands-on CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native services, and production monitoring and troubleshooting. At Turbot HQ — a multi-cloud security, governance, and compliance software company — built a Kafka-based policy-enforcement pipeline and cut resource-discovery latency 70–90% by migrating 35+ cloud-governance modules to event-driven architecture.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
work.domainNote: Multi-cloud security, governance, and compliance software; makers of the open-source Steampipe / Powerpipe / Flowpipe / Tailpipe suite and the commercial Turbot Guardrails PSPM platform. Remote-first.
highlights: Designed and built an internal REST microservice in Golang (Gin) as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a cloud security SaaS product; secured with OAuth 2.0 (Auth0), containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for internal microservices.

Built a Kafka-based event-driven pipeline processing policy-enforcement events asynchronously and firing a webhook once a policy was enforced against a cloud resource, with a dead-letter queue (DLQ) for failure investigation and debugging.

Led the AWS SDK v2→v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services in production Node.js Lambdas, reducing policy-code duplication ~60% and unblocking a Node.js runtime upgrade past AWS SDK v2 EOL.

Authored 11 AWS log-source tables (Golang) for data visibility across CloudTrail, GuardDuty, SecurityHub, VPC flow, and WAF logs plus 25+ security detections, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs/sec.

Authored multi-cloud compliance modules (HCL + SQL, 1,000+ resource checks) across CIS, NIST, HIPAA, PCI DSS v4, SOC 2, and FedRAMP frameworks for enterprise finance/healthcare/government customers, cutting compliance-audit time 50%.

Owned CI/CD release engineering for four open-source Golang CLIs — unified GitHub Actions pipelines with automated multi-distro Linux smoke tests, hardening release safety and catching regressions before deployment.
